web-guide-idea-6.audience: People curious about how another Indian household celebrates.
web-guide-idea-6.offer: Invite viewers into one consenting family’s preparations and customs. The offer is a personal cultural visit with context, not a staged claim to represent every household.
web-guide-idea-6.steps.0: Agree which family moments may be shown.
web-guide-idea-6.steps.1: Explain the decorations, food and one central tradition.
web-guide-idea-6.steps.2: Pause for questions and close before private family time.
web-guide-idea-6.equipment: A phone, simple stand and Wi-Fi. A movable grip helps switch between the kitchen and decorated corner.
web-guide-idea-6.returnReason: Offer distinct celebrations through the year and explain how your family’s customs change. Familiar details help viewers connect with your household.
web-guide-idea-6.promotion: Show one decoration in a teaser and tell viewers which tradition they will learn about.
web-guide-idea-6.metadataTitle: Ghar Ka Festival — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-6.metadataDescription: Share your household's Ganesh Chaturthi, Navratri, Onam or Pongal traditions with everyone's consent. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
